notes:
• New: the Planner, a third tool for making the worship team's schedule. Enter the team, their roles, the Sundays they can't serve and what a service needs, then build each month by hand or with Auto-fill.
• Auto-fill shares the Sundays fairly: everyone gets one before anyone gets a second. It looks back at the months before, prefers the roles people usually do, and keeps people who serve together on the same Sundays. Every slot says why its person is there.
• Standing rules such as "1st and 3rd Sundays only", weeks that practise on Sunday morning, and who leads a song each week.
• In a pinch, anyone can be put in any slot. It shows in amber so it isn't lost sight of.
• Share a month as a one-page PDF of the grid, as text, or copy one person's dates to send to them.
• Team members with the library link see the whole month, and their own Sundays on a Me tab.
